# TeamBlind Topic, Company & Post Thread Extractor

TeamBlind is an anonymous workplace community where tech employees at Google, Apple, Microsoft, Meta, Amazon and thousands of other companies post about layoffs, compensation, interviews and career moves. This actor searches posts by keyword, browses a topic or company feed, or fetches a single post thread with its comments.

## What this actor does

- **Five modes:** `searchPosts` (keyword search), `byTopic` (browse a topic feed like Career or Compensation), `byCompany` (browse one or more company feeds), `byPost` (single thread with full body and comments), `byUrl` (paste any teamblind.com URL and the actor detects which of the above it is)
- **15 topic feeds** and free-text company slugs (e.g. `Google`, `Amazon`, `Meta`, `Stripe`) to browse without searching
- **Sort control** for topic/company feeds — newest or most popular
- **Korea region support** — switch `country` to `kr` to read kr.teamblind.com instead of the US/India host
- **Empty fields are omitted** — a record only carries the fields TeamBlind actually published for that post or comment

## Authentication

`searchPosts`, `byTopic`, and `byCompany` work without any credentials. `byPost` (and `byUrl` when it resolves to a single post) needs a logged-in session to retrieve the full thread body, so it requires `cookieHeader`: sign in at teamblind.com, open your browser's DevTools Network tab, copy the full `Cookie` request header value from any request to teamblind.com (it should contain `b_session_id=...`), and paste it into `cookieHeader`. Without it, `byPost` fails with a clear status message rather than returning an empty or fake thread.

## Output per post

- `id`, `alias` — numeric post ID and URL-safe alias
- `articleType` — TeamBlind's internal post-type tag
- `title`, `content` — post title and body text
- `memberNickname` — author's anonymized handle
- `boardName`, `boardId`, `channelId` — board/company/region label and its numeric IDs
- `createdAt` — relative time as shown by TeamBlind (e.g. `"4d"`, `"1h"`)
- `writedAt` — ISO 8601 absolute timestamp
- `likeCount`, `commentCount`, `viewCount` — engagement counts
- `isPoll`, `isHot`, `isHighlight`, `isAuth`, `isHiddenCompany` — status flags, when TeamBlind sets them
- `tags[]` — tags attached to the post, when any exist
- `wasCompanies[]` — author's previously listed companies, when shown
- `url` — direct post URL
- `sourceType` — where the post was found: `search` / `topic` / `company` / `post`
- `recordType` — always `post`

## Output per comment (mode `byPost`, when `includeComments=true`)

- `id` — numeric comment ID
- `parentPostAlias` — alias of the parent post
- `content` — comment text
- `memberNickname` — author handle
- `createdAt`, `writedAt` — relative and absolute timestamps
- `likeCount`, `replyCount` — engagement counts
- `boardName` — board label
- `isAuth` — status flag, when TeamBlind sets it
- `url` — parent post URL
- `sourceType` — always `comment`
- `recordType` — always `comment`

## Output per error

Emitted instead of a post/comment when a fetch fails or TeamBlind returns a logged-out page: `url`, `reason` (e.g. `login_wall`, `fetch_failed`, `no_post_found`), `httpStatus` (when known), plus the requested context (`sourceType`, and `topic`/`query`/`company` depending on mode). `recordType` is always `error`.

## Input

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | string | `searchPosts` | `searchPosts` / `byPost` / `byTopic` / `byCompany` / `byUrl` |
| `query` | string | `layoffs` | Keyword search text (mode=`searchPosts`) |
| `topic` | string | `Career` | Topic feed to browse (mode=`byTopic`) |
| `companies` | array | `["Google"]` | Company slugs to browse (mode=`byCompany`) |
| `postUrls` | array | – | Full teamblind.com URLs (mode=`byPost`/`byUrl`) |
| `sortBy` | string | `newest` | `newest` / `popular` (mode=`byTopic`/`byCompany`) |
| `country` | string | `us` | `us` / `kr` / `in` — region host to read |
| `includeComments` | boolean | `true` | Emit each comment as its own record (mode=`byPost`) |
| `cookieHeader` | string | – | Logged-in TeamBlind cookie; required for `byPost` |
| `maxItems` | integer | `50` | Hard cap on emitted records, posts + comments + errors combined (1–1000) |
| `autoEscalateOnBlock` | boolean | `true` | Automatically switch to a residential proxy if TeamBlind returns a 403/429 block |
| `proxyGroups` | array | – | Apify proxy groups to use if auto-escalation triggers; empty uses the default fallback |

### Example: keyword search

```json
{
  "mode": "searchPosts",
  "query": "layoffs",
  "maxItems": 50
}
```

### Example: browse a topic feed by popularity

```json
{
  "mode": "byTopic",
  "topic": "Compensation",
  "sortBy": "popular",
  "maxItems": 30
}
```

### Example: company feeds

```json
{
  "mode": "byCompany",
  "companies": ["Google", "Meta", "Stripe"],
  "maxItems": 60
}
```

### Example: full thread with comments

```json
{
  "mode": "byPost",
  "postUrls": ["https://www.teamblind.com/post/example-alias"],
  "includeComments": true,
  "cookieHeader": "b_session_id=...; b_user=...",
  "maxItems": 100
}
```

## Use cases

- **Tech-industry sentiment tracking** — monitor keyword mentions of layoffs, compensation bands, or a specific employer
- **Compensation research** — pull Compensation-topic posts to see real discussions around pay and RSUs
- **Company reputation monitoring** — track what current/former employees post in a company's feed
- **HR and recruiting intelligence** — read Interview/Career threads to understand candidate sentiment
- **Thread archiving** — save a full post and its comment thread for later reference via `byPost`

## FAQ

**Do I need a TeamBlind account?** Only for `byPost`. The other four modes read publicly accessible feed and search pages without any login.

**Why did `byPost` return an error record instead of the thread?** It means `cookieHeader` is missing or has expired — TeamBlind served a logged-out page instead of the full thread. Re-export a fresh cookie and try again.

**Are post `id` and `alias` stable?** Yes — both are stable identifiers you can reuse to build deep links or re-fetch the same thread later.

**What's the difference between `createdAt` and `writedAt`?** `createdAt` is the relative time string TeamBlind itself displays (e.g. `"4d"`); `writedAt` is the same moment converted to an absolute ISO 8601 timestamp for sorting/filtering.

**Does this cover TeamBlind's Korean site?** Yes — set `country` to `kr` to read kr.teamblind.com instead of the US/India host; topic names differ there, so use `byUrl` with a Korean feed link if a topic isn't in the dropdown.

**When does the proxy escalation kick in?** Only if TeamBlind responds with a block (403/429); with `autoEscalateOnBlock` left on, the actor retries through a residential proxy automatically.

**Why are some posts missing `tags` or `wasCompanies`?** Those fields only exist when the author added tags or TeamBlind displays their post history of previous employers; most posts don't have either.

**Is this affiliated with TeamBlind?** No, this is an independent third-party actor that reads TeamBlind's public and (for `byPost`) authenticated pages using your own session. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Team Blind Inc.
